breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-II (English) — History Unit 2: Great Thinkers and New Faiths — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: As a land mark period in the intellectual and spiritual development in India, historian Will Durant has rightly called it the 'shower of stars'.

en.q: Historian Will Durant called the sixth century BCE in India the '______'.
en.explanation: It was a landmark period of intellectual and spiritual development.

ta.q: வரலாற்றாளர் வில் டூரன்ட் கி.மு. ஆறாம் நூற்றாண்டை '______' என்று குறிப்பிட்டார்.
ta.explanation: இந்தியாவின் அறிவு, ஆன்மிக வளர்ச்சியின் அடையாளக் காலம்.

questions.quote: Literary sources: Angas – Jain texts; Tripitakas and Jatakas – Buddhist texts.

en.q: The Angas are the ______ texts.
en.explanation: The Angas are Jain texts; the Tripitakas and Jatakas are Buddhist texts.

ta.explanation: அங்கங்கள் சமண நூல்கள்; திரிபீடகங்கள், ஜாதகங்கள் பௌத்த நூல்கள்.

questions.quote: Jainism is one of the world's oldest living religions. A 'Tirthankara' is the one who revealed religious truth at different times. The first Tirthankara was Rishabha and the last one was Mahavira.

en.q: The last Tirthankara of Jainism was ______.
en.explanation: Rishabha was the first and Mahavira the last Tirthankara.

ta.explanation: ரிஷபநாதர் முதல், மகாவீரர் இறுதித் தீர்த்தங்கரர்.

questions.quote: Mahavira: Original name - Vardhamana; Place of Birth - Kundhagrama near Vaishali, Bihar; Parents - Siddharth, Trishala; Place of Death - Pavapuri, Bihar.

en.q: Mahavira's original name was ______.
en.explanation: Vardhamana (meaning 'prosperous') was born at Kundhagrama near Vaishali, Bihar, to Siddharth and Trishala.

ta.explanation: வர்த்தமானர் (செழிப்பு) வைசாலி அருகே குந்தக்கிராமத்தில் சித்தார்த்தர்-திரிசலைக்குப் பிறந்தார்.

questions.quote: Vardhamana was a kshatriya prince. However, at the age of 30, he renounced his princely status to adopt an ascetic life. After twelve and a half years of rigorous penance, Vardhamana attained omniscience or supreme knowledge, known as Kevala.

en.q: Supreme knowledge, or omniscience, attained by Mahavira after rigorous penance is known as ______.
en.explanation: Omniscience is the ability to know everything.

ta.q: கடுமையான தவத்துக்குப்பின் மகாவீரர் அடைந்த முழுமையான அறிவு ______ எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: 12½ ஆண்டுத் தவத்துக்குப்பின் கேவல ஞானம் பெற்றார்.

questions.quote: Unique Teachings of Jainism: Jainism denies God as the creator of Universe. Basic philosophy of Jainism is Ahimsa. Ultimate aim is attaining moksha. Jains reject the belief in Last judgement. Goodness or quality of one's life is determined by one's karma.

en.q: The basic philosophy of Jainism is ______.
en.explanation: The ultimate aim of Jainism is moksha, ending the cycle of birth-death-rebirth.

ta.explanation: சமணத்தின் இறுதி நோக்கம் மோட்சம்.

questions.quote: Digambaras are orthodox and conservative followers. Monks of the digambara sect do not wear any clothing. The Svetambaras are considered progressive. Monks of Svetambaras sect wear white robes.

en.q: The Jain monks who wear white robes belong to the ______ sect.
en.explanation: Digambara monks wear no clothing.

ta.q: வெள்ளை ஆடை அணியும் சமணத் துறவிகள் ______ பிரிவைச் சேர்ந்தவர்கள்.
ta.explanation: திகம்பரத் துறவிகள் ஆடையின்றி இருப்பர்.

questions.quote: Reasons for the Spread of Jainism: Use of people's language; Intelligible teachings; Support from rulers and traders; Perseverance of Jain monks.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT given as a reason for the spread of Jainism?
options: Use of Sanskrit as the language of teaching
en.explanation: The reasons also include the perseverance of Jain monks.

ta.explanation: சமணத் துறவிகளின் விடாமுயற்சியும் ஒரு காரணம்.

questions.quote: There is a reference to Aravor Palli, place of living for Jain monks, in Manimegalai.

en.q: The 'Aravor Palli', a place of living for Jain monks, is referred to in ______.
en.explanation: Manimegalai refers to Aravor Palli.

ta.q: சமணத் துறவிகள் வாழ்ந்த 'அறவோர் பள்ளி' ______ இல் குறிப்பிடப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: மணிமேகலையில் அறவோர் பள்ளி பற்றிய குறிப்பு உள்ளது.

questions.quote: Gautama Buddha: Original name - Siddhartha; Place of Birth - Lumbini Garden, Nepal; Parents - Suddhodana, Maya devi; Place of Death - Kushi Nagar, UP. He belonged to the ruling Sakya clan. His mother died when he was seven days old, so he was raised by his step mother Gautami.

en.q: Gautama Buddha was born at ______.
en.explanation: He died at Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh.

ta.explanation: அவர் உத்தரப் பிரதேசத்தின் குசிநகரில் மறைந்தார்.

questions.quote: Four Great Sights: At the age of 29, Siddhartha saw four sorrowful sights: an uncared old man, a sick man, a corpse being carried by weeping relatives, and an ascetic.

en.q: Which of the following was NOT one of the four great sights seen by Siddhartha?
options: A corpse carried by weeping relatives
en.explanation: The fourth sight was an ascetic.

ta.q: சித்தார்த்தர் கண்ட நான்கு பெரிய காட்சிகளுள் இல்லாதது எது?
ta.explanation: நான்காவது காட்சி ஒரு துறவி.

questions.quote: He sacrificed six years of his life towards penance. Buddha sat under a Pipal tree and undertook a deep meditation near Gaya. On the 49th day he finally attained enlightenment. He was also known as Sakya Muni or Sage of Sakya clan.

en.q: Buddha attained enlightenment sitting under a ______ tree near Gaya.
en.explanation: After enlightenment he was called Buddha or the Enlightened One.

ta.q: கயா அருகே புத்தர் ஞானம் பெற்றது ______ மரத்தடியில்.
ta.explanation: ஞானம் பெற்றபின் அவர் புத்தர் (ஞானம் பெற்றவர்) எனப்பட்டார்.

questions.quote: Buddha delivered his first sermon at Deer Park in Sarnath, near Benaras. This was called 'Dharma Chakra Pravartana' or the Turning of the Wheel of Law.

en.q: 'Dharma Chakra Pravartana' refers to ______.
en.explanation: It means the Turning of the Wheel of Law.

ta.explanation: இதன் பொருள் அறவாழிச் சக்கரத்தைச் சுழற்றுதல்.

questions.quote: Buddha's Four Noble Truths: Life is full of sorrow and misery. Desire is the cause of misery. Sorrows and sufferings can be removed by giving up one's desire. The desire can be overcome by following the right path (Noble eight-fold path).

en.q: According to Buddha, the cause of misery is ______.
en.explanation: Sorrow can be removed by giving up desire through the Noble Eight-fold Path.

ta.explanation: ஆசையைத் துறப்பதன் மூலம் துன்பத்தை நீக்கலாம்; அதற்கு எண்வகை நெறி (அட்டாங்க மார்க்கம்).

questions.quote: Teachings of Buddha: Buddha's teachings are referred to as dhamma. Buddhism accepted the Theory of Karma. Buddha asserted that attaining nirvana is the ultimate aim of life. Buddha advocated ahimsa. Buddha had rejected the caste system.

en.q: Buddha's teachings are referred to as ______.
en.explanation: Buddha asserted that attaining nirvana is the ultimate aim of life.

ta.explanation: நிர்வாணம் அடைவதே வாழ்வின் இறுதி நோக்கம் என்றார்.

questions.quote: Buddha laid foundation for a missionary organization called Sangha, meaning 'association'. The members were called bhikshus (monks). Chaitya – A Buddhist shrine or a meditation hall. Viharas – Monasteries. Stupas – Built over the remains of Buddha's body.

en.q: The missionary organisation founded by Buddha to propagate his faith was the ______.
en.explanation: The members of the Sangha were called bhikshus (monks).

ta.q: புத்தர் தம் சமயத்தைப் பரப்ப நிறுவிய அமைப்பு ______.
ta.explanation: சங்கத்தின் உறுப்பினர்கள் பிக்குகள்.

questions.quote: Buddhist Sects: Hinayana - did not worship idols, practised austerity, used Prakrit; also known as Theravada; spread to Sri Lanka, Myanmar and South East Asia. Mahayana - worshipped images of Buddha, used Sanskrit; spread to Central Asia, Tibet, China and Japan.

en.q: Which Buddhist sect worshipped images of Buddha and spread to China and Japan?
en.explanation: Hinayana (Theravada) did not worship idols and spread to Sri Lanka and Myanmar.

ta.q: புத்தரின் உருவச் சிலைகளை வழிபட்டு சீனா, ஜப்பானுக்குப் பரவிய பௌத்தப் பிரிவு எது?
ta.explanation: ஹீனயானம் (தேரவாதம்) சிலை வழிபாடின்றி இலங்கை, மியான்மருக்குப் பரவியது.

questions.quote: Viharas or the Buddhist monasteries became great centres of education. One such centre was Nalanda, where Hiuen Tsang, the Chinese pilgrim, studied for many years. Frescoes on the ceilings and walls of the Ajanta caves in Aurangabad, Maharashtra depict the Jataka Tales.

en.q: The Ajanta caves, whose frescoes depict the Jataka Tales, are in ______.
en.explanation: Ajanta caves are near Aurangabad, Maharashtra.

ta.q: ஜாதகக் கதைகளை விளக்கும் ஓவியங்கள் உள்ள அஜந்தா குகைகள் ______ மாநிலத்தில் உள்ளன.
ta.explanation: அஜந்தா குகைகள் ஔரங்காபாத் அருகே உள்ளன.

questions.quote: Buddhist Councils: First - Rajagriha; Second - Vaishali; Third - Pataliputra; Fourth - Kashmir.

en.q: The second Buddhist Council was held at ______.
en.explanation: First - Rajagriha; Second - Vaishali; Third - Pataliputra; Fourth - Kashmir.

ta.explanation: முதல் - இராஜகிருகம்; இரண்டாவது - வைசாலி; மூன்றாவது - பாடலிபுத்திரம்; நான்காவது - காஷ்மீர்.

questions.quote: Manimekalai, one of the epics of the post-Sangam age is a Buddhist literature. Kanchipuram was a famous Buddhist Centre, from where Dinnaga, the famous Buddhist logician, and Dharmapala, a great scholar of Nalanda University hailed.

en.q: The Tamil epic that is a Buddhist literature is ______.
en.explanation: Manimekalai is a post-Sangam epic.

ta.explanation: சங்கம் மருவிய காலக் காப்பியமான மணிமேகலை பௌத்த நூல்.

questions.quote: Jainism followed extreme path; Buddhism followed middle path. Jainism remained in India only; Buddhism spread across many parts of the world. Both denied the authority of Vedas, taught in the language of the common people and opposed blood sacrifices.

en.q: Which of the following is common to both Jainism and Buddhism?
options: Both rejected the Vedas and accepted karma
Both worshipped one supreme creator God
Both began as religions of foreign lands
Both supported animal sacrifices in rituals
en.explanation: Both taught in the language of the common people and admitted disciples of all castes.

ta.explanation: இரண்டும் மக்கள் மொழியில் போதித்து எல்லாச் சாதியினரையும் சேர்த்தன.

questions.quote: Elsewhere in the world 6th Century BC (BCE): Confucius (Kung Fu Tse) - Confucianism in China; Zoroaster - Zoroastrianism in Persia.

en.q: Zoroastrianism, which arose in the sixth century BCE, was founded in ______.
en.explanation: Confucianism arose in China.

ta.q: கி.மு. ஆறாம் நூற்றாண்டில் தோன்றிய ஜொராஸ்ட்ரிய மதம் ______ நாட்டில் தோன்றியது.
ta.explanation: கன்ஃபூசியம் சீனாவில் தோன்றியது.
